name: Seragaki Aoba
source:
"Not happening. I keep telling you."

A young man who values his peace and quiet. Despite his protests, Aoba has a hard time refusing people in need. An optimist at heart, he rarely gets angry, but when he does, expect him to deliver an explosive kick or two. He’s been plagued by chronic headaches for as long as he can remember.

[From the digital manual included with r76424]
